inputs.text:
Look, folks, we are watching the total collapse of basic common sense and law and order in our cities, driven straight down from the top by reckless, progressive sanctuary policies. The Department of Homeland Security just announced the arrest of an illegal immigrant gang member by ICE after he was released by New York City authorities despite posing a danger to public safety. 

This is exactly what happens when local politicians put left-wing ideology and lawless sanctuary agendas ahead of the safety of our families and communities. Instead of upholding the rule of law and protecting our borders, these sanctuary cities are actively harboring dangerous criminals with criminal records right back onto our streets. DHS is entirely right to call out New York City for these reckless actions. It is time to restore basic authority, put public safety first, and demand real accountability instead of coddling criminals at the expense of everyday citizens.
